raw_requirement: Create an 18 kW motor drive panel using Schneider ATV630

extracted_params.application: 18.5 kW Industrial Variable Speed Drive Panel
extracted_params.enclosure_type: Standard Industrial Floor/Wall Mount Enclosure (Rittal / Schneider)
extracted_params.control_philosophy: Local / Remote with Safety E-Stop and Modbus RTU interface

provisional_assumptions: Motor is standard IEC 18.5 kW (approx 25 HP) 415V 50Hz 3-phase induction motor with 38A FLA.
Schneider ATV630D18N4 VFD selected (39.2A continuous rating, 455W heat dissipation).
3% AC input line reactor included for harmonic mitigation and mains spike protection.
Enclosure 800 x 1200 x 400 mm IP54 provides 740 x 1060 mm net usable mounting plate area.
DIN rails and wiring ducts are workspace-only objects and excluded from the Bill of Materials.
